video_captions_audio_20261103.status: DONE - library modules, probes and tests; endpoint wiring is the next unit; fragment pending operator merge

captions.contract: cue boxes inside the platform safe area; OCR of a cue-midpoint frame reads the words; a box under the strip or unreadable text is refused

audio.contract: voice via local Piper/SAPI, generated royalty-free bed or supplied track, sidechain ducking, two-pass loudnorm -16 LUFS, AAC mux with the picture copied, measured not silent

gaps: no HTTP endpoint yet for captions or audio
transcription is segment-timed by default; word_timestamps=True is supported and used when present, but the 15s video's captions are scene copy, not a transcript
the generated bed is a pad, not a licensed song; music= accepts a real track
ducking is verified by the applied filter + measured mix, not a spectral A/B
captions are OCR-checked one frame per cue
video_captions_audio_20261103.gates_held: No Amazon, no spend, no download, no credential read. Piper and ffmpeg are local.
